Name: Hi-Res Weapons - Breath of the Wild
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
All swords, daggers, and clubs (other than ones sold by NPCs) are reskinned as a weapon from Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. 

This uses Scale Up 2 to make them a higher resolution

Some of them are not exactly the same as from BOTW, I changed some of their sizes and colors

This is a list of each weapon changed and their counterpart:

[*]Rusty sword - rusty broadsword

[*]Steel smallsword - soldier’s broadsword

[*]Wooden blade - training sword

[*]Pirate’s sword - moonlight scimitar

[*]Cutlass - eightfold blade

[*]Insect head - forked lizal spear

[*]Claymore - traveler’s claymore
